game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood, the glowing ancient tree: the forest ranger must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Stride Selector: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones.
theme: Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood: the glowing ancient tree
core_gameplay_loop: In Glowing Heartwood, repeat each round: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the stones value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the spirit shrine using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The spirit shrine reached with actions_used <= 20.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the spirit shrine is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Stride Selector
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stride Selector' (Week 5 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Glowing Heartwood'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stones changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wolves in Glowing Heartwood.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The spirit shrine reached with actions_used <= 20.
